notes.title: Shiperoids Unity Port Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925863/1ca594eff7f948e68cc9c367a48f60c69da244b5.jpg[/img]

I have made a fair bit of progress porting Shiperoids to Unity. I am not a programmer but I am a quick study.  Also I have found a plethora of tools to help this poor artist get this game working.  

I got the basic game up and running with pseudo multiplayer (On The Same Machine!) actual co-op coming later. Controller support now works with your choice of old school mouse mode, keyboard, joystick, or D-pad aiming.  You can now play at almost any resolution you like.

 I intentionally made the playfield scale with the window size. That means if you have a 5200 x 1200 monitor it will be filled with Shiperoids.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925863/b93f8a6ac17692ac9d05f4ab1117fa888236accc.jpg[/img]

Also, if you're one of those weirdos that plays with there monitor rotated in the vertical position it will work that way as well.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25925863/85573ec3f474608d2c1f38b82e6729271b84245e.jpg[/img]

The only downside to all this awesomeness is that the file size of the game has ballooned to about 5 times the size at 35 megabytes. Along with the fancy new rendering engine I am going to need to do some major performance tweaks to get the craziness of hundreds of ships running on the screen at the same time.

All and all it is coming along nicely and I will post a playable soon so I can get some feedback on the systems I do have in place and iterate on those.

P.S. Happy 50th Star Trek!

VERSION 0.06 
Fixed spelling error "wall" 
Fixed score cut off for 7 digit numbers 
Fixed FX and Collision on wave complete 
Added check for save game on intro screen if it doesnt exist 
Added Debug Cheats - 
Press "C" when the start screen loads (you have 3 sec). 
1 - spawn more ships 
2 - spawn bombs 
3 - complete the wave 
will say debug mode at the top and display ship count at the bottom when your playing.

notes.title: Going to break your save games tomorrow. Back up your game.
notes.content:
Each new version is not backwards compatible with the save games. 

If you don't want to loose your progress copy your Shiperoids folder(Shiperoids.exe and saves folder) from the steam folder to some other location and run it from the new location.  

This along with several other limitations of the game engine is why I want to port it to Unity, so I can do more cool stuff like better saves, co-op and controller support. It also means that this is going to be the last update for a while so I can do some tedious porting work.

Tomorrows update....

notes.title: Shiperoids Dev Plan
notes.content:
Shiperoids Development
Plan

Unity Port,

Currently I am in the process of porting Shiperoids to Unity. It's a straightforward process, all the assets are already created, but it's time consuming. Once I have a 1:1 clone of it in Unity I will push out that update and then start adding features and changes to the new Unity build. 

Please be patient, Shiperoids is a priority for me but I also work and go to school full time so updates may not come as quickly as you want them too.

New Features

[list]
	[*]
Custom Controls -
	I want to add multiple control inputs, mouse, keyboard, custom
	analog dial (for full size arcade machines). Also a way to fully
	customize the controls to your liking.

	[*]
More power-ups –
	Not just random bombs but guided missiles, friendly turrets, super
	laser, stuff like that. I would love some ideas and input on this if
	anyone has them.

	[*]
Larger Play Field -
	This one is going to need some tweaking but a 1024 screen is
	a bit small for my taste. I don't want a scrolling universe just
	something with some more room to move around in.

	[*]
Multiplayer –
	First up is local co-op/VS which is not hard at all to get
	working at all, but not everyone has their friend sitting next to
	them on the couch so online co-op and VS is a must for me.  Problem
	is online multiplayer is hard. Doing it right and not pushing out
	some broken piece of garbage is really important to me so please be
	patient.

	[*]
Modding- 
        If it's	worth it, AND people want it, I would like to add an easy way
        the player can mod the game. I think its great fun to put your own stuff 
        into a game and fly around in it. Ideally I would make it super simple so you could upload your own sprites in the game itself. I think it would be lots of fun.

[/list]

The biggest request I have is “Why did I bounce off the wall? I want to warp to the other side like Asteroids.”  Well it's not Asteroids, it's Shiperoids, and I don't own the rights to Asteroids so that's why I made a different game.  It's only inspired by classics from the 80's and not a copy of any game in particular. 

Also
 I have been legally advised to mention this - Asteroids is copyrighted by Atari 1981, and any similarities between Shiperoids and any other game living or dead is purely coincidental.
